author: BerrySmooothie
body:
1. What kind of team player are you?
 a) A defender
 b) A rusher
 c) A (wall) to stop people from coming into your territory
 d) Collect iron or diamond for your team
2. How long do you play on average a day?
 a) 1 hour
 b) more than 3 hours
 c) 2 hours
 d) less that 1 hour or none
3. What kind of mode do you play?
 a) Nebula
 b) Nexus
 c) Walls
 d) Avicade
4. What do you like to collect in Nebula?
 a) food
 b) swords
 c) armour
 d) none

Mostly got:
a)'s : Very cautious for the things for you and your team, you like to play sustain ably and like to play challenging but an exciting game!
b)'s: You like to be very challenging and there is not much patience in you because you love to win, you are quite addicted to Avicus and you really like and are good PVP!
c)'s: You are protective of your team's area(which is a good thing) and likes to play Avicus for quite a long time and you like to be always prepared for team's attack.
d)'s: You want your team to win by getting some good armor and like to provide armor for mates. You like to play mini games and even though you like the server you don't have much time to play on it!

So thats it guys! Hope you liked this little game and comment below what letter you got, or your answers! 
P.S. Happy Birthday americangirl2304!

Alicia_Nirui123 xx
